create_glm46v_image_processor: create a Glm46VImageProcessor instance with custom patch_size, temporal_patch_size, and merge_size kwargs
run_smart_resize: run smart_resize to compute valid height, width, and frame dimensions for GLM-4V image input
preprocess_glm46v_images: preprocess a list of PIL images for GLM-4V by resizing, rescaling, normalizing, and patching
get_number_of_image_patches: get the number of image patches for a given height and width using smart_resize and patch parameters
